dsh-permission-rules is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Declarative allow/deny/ask permission rules plus Codex-style per-process network policy (with a built-in local HTTP/CONNECT proxy), full audit logging and hot rule reload.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-94e11b5a803913eafd2d.html
